verdict.rationale: The firm runs an openly accessible publications library of "guides and reports" with founder-relevant pieces: a detailed analysis of India's 2026 Startup Notification (recognition thresholds, deep-tech pathway, flip-structure ineligibility) and an ESOP buyback tax explainer covering equity. These are legal-update analyses rather than a structured, plain-language startup knowledge base, and the practice pages are service descriptions, not explainers. missing for 10: a dedicated startup hub or FAQ section, plain-language guides on company formation and fundraising/financing rounds, broader equity coverage beyond one ESOP tax ruling, independent corroboration.
